In this week’s episode, #AshleyGraham gets real with the legendary #KellyRowland. The two talk Kelly’s new music, both being mamas, manifesting your greatness, and checking your haters. Kelly opens up about working with #Beyoncé on Black is King, producing and acting in her new Lifetime Christmas movie, and she even shares a hilarious story about the Tooth Fairy.
